question: Does the component ATtiny45-20P have flash capabilities according to its datasheet?

response.reasoning: The ATtiny45-20P datasheet (referenced in the netlist as http://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/atmel-2586-avr-8-bit-microcontroller-attiny25-attiny45-attiny85_datasheet.pdf) is for the ATtiny25/45/85 family, which are AVR microcontrollers with built-in Flash program memory (4KB for ATtiny45).
